gate: docs/ROADMAP-PLATFORM.md M5: the same scene in Mitsuba Metal and V100 CUDA, grade B, with the PSNR limit set before measuring

known_before_this_commit.note: validation/spikes.json. One pair of one scene. No CUDA image had been rendered.

scenes: cornell_spheres (the same box with one conductor and one dielectric sphere)
protocol.note: The seed sets are separate, so shared random numbers cannot flatter the result. Each scene must pass by itself.

limits.channel_mean: max(3 standard errors of the difference in means, 1% of the golden mean)
limits.inconclusive: Two seeds on one device under the floor: the noise is too high to judge. This is not a pass.

reasons.psnr_floor_db: 12 dB under the M0 pair. It is a floor for gross errors. By itself it would miss small errors, so the noise ratio does that work.
reasons.noise_ratio: If the two devices compute the same estimator, the MSE across devices equals the MSE between two seeds. A ratio of 2 is about 3 dB, and it allows one device to be noisier than the other without hiding a bias of the size of the noise.
reasons.channel_mean: The rule of cumlx rundiff grade B, for a brightness error that the noise covers per pixel.

synthetic_cases.right: the same image with other noise: grade B
wrong: +0.02 in one corner, which stays above the 40 dB floor
